title: Advocates Act, 1961 — Section 29 (Advocates to be the only recognised class of persons entitled to practise law)

content.overview: Section 29 provides that, subject to the Act, only advocates are entitled to practise the profession of law.
content.glance: Section 29 provides that, subject to the Act, only advocates are entitled to practise the profession of law.
content.study: Subject to the provisions of the Advocates Act and any other law, there shall be only one class of persons entitled to practise the profession of law, namely advocates.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 29 provides that, subject to the Act, only advocates are entitled to practise the profession of law.
